name: UCLA Weeknights I 2026
information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCLAWeeknightsI2026#83256-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [Cubing Club @ UCLA](https://linktr.ee/cubing_club_at_UCLA?utm_source=linktree_profile_share&ltsid=88bd73bf-5f42-46f9-a65f-7b2ce5ede711). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjMxMDQxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--049a36d7432ebb69dbda8d946fe1c8bb0ea3974e/UCLA_Cube_Club_Logo_1%20(1).png)
